# SBTech Consulting

> SBTech Consulting is an independent, vendor-neutral IT and AI consulting practice based in Palmer, Massachusetts, helping small businesses adopt technology effectively and affordably. Founded in 2014 by Joseph P. Nompleggi. Tagline: "Simplified Technology for SMBs."

SBTech Consulting provides unbiased technology guidance — no vendor commissions or software agendas. Services span everyday IT support and managed services through to practical AI consulting for small businesses. The practice maintains strict professional confidentiality, never sells client data, and uses secure, encrypted communication channels (multi-factor authentication and encrypted remote management tools).

## About the owner

- Name: Joseph P. Nompleggi
- Role: Founder & Principal Consultant
- Founded: 2014 (Palmer, MA)
- Business structure: Independent consultancy (the former LLC was voluntarily dissolved in 2025 to operate as a lean independent practice)
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/joseph-nompleggi-0834941b
- Facebook: https://facebook.com/SBTechOnline/
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/NompleggiJoseph

## Services

- AI Consulting & Automation: workflow automation, AI assistants and chatbots, smart data insights, AI strategy and training, tool integration, and safe/private AI guidance
- Vendor-Agnostic IT Support: unbiased technology guidance without vendor commissions
- Managed Services: ongoing, hands-off management of technology for a predictable cost
- Hardware procurement and computer management
- Software licensing
- Comprehensive training
- Networking and installation
- Security audits and monitoring
- Patching, repairs, and virus removal
- Troubleshooting and break/fix solutions
- Website design

## Areas of expertise

- Technology Consulting — system integration, software development, IT support
- Operations Management — process optimization and efficiency
- Project Management — oversight of IT and website projects
- Data Analytics — data-driven insights for decision-making
- Change Management — organizational transitions and technology integration
